# Third-party notices

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-third-party-notices.mjs; do not edit.
     `pnpm notices:check` fails when this file drifts from the release set. -->

Varlatch's own code is covered by [LICENSE](LICENSE). A Varlatch release
also runs, or contains, the third-party components below. Each is under
its own license.

**The Convex backend is source-available, not open source.** It is
licensed under FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0: internal use is permitted, making it
available to others as a competing commercial product or service is not,
and each version becomes Apache-2.0 two years after its release.
Self-hosting Varlatch for your own organization is internal use. The
Convex client library and CLI (`convex` on npm) are Apache-2.0.

## Container images the release runs

| Component | Image | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Caddy | `caddy:2.10.2` | [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy/blob/master/LICENSE) |
| Convex backend | `ghcr.io/get-convex/convex-backend@sha256:1f2044e3eac463ac78973b136c0baf72d4ada602611d853d6f99f280e29e0a98` | [FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0](https://github.com/get-convex/convex-backend/blob/main/LICENSE.md) |
| PostgreSQL | `postgres:17.6` | [PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/about/licence/) |
| Tailscale | `tailscale/tailscale:v1.102.3` | [BSD-3-Clause](https://github.com/tailscale/tailscale/blob/main/LICENSE) |

The release manifest (`varlatch-release.json`) pins each of these by digest.

## Base images of Varlatch's images

| Base image | Used by | License | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nginx:1.29-alpine` | varlatch-web | BSD-2-Clause (nginx) | nginx on Alpine Linux; Alpine packages are under their own licenses |
| `node:26-slim` | convex-deploy, varlatch-web, varlatchd | MIT (Node.js) | Node.js, whose LICENSE lists the components it bundles, on Debian; Debian packages are under their own licenses |

The convex-deploy image also contains `generate_key` from the Convex
backend image above, under the same FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0 license.

## npm packages

"Shipped in" names the artifact that contains each package: the
**varlatchd** image, the operator **CLI** bundle (a release asset, also
inside the varlatchd image), the **dashboard** bundle in the varlatch-web
image, and the **convex-deploy** image. For the CLI and the dashboard the
list is each artifact's full production dependency closure, a superset of
what the bundler includes.
